jobs.name: SpeakerAgent PR positives → Slack C0AFU5EH56X
jobs.prompt:
Check the SmartLead master inbox for NEW positive replies on campaign 3577260 ("PR Agencies - SpeakerAgent v2 - July 2026") that arrived since the last run.

WORKFLOW:
1. Fetch inbox replies via SmartLead CLI: `smartlead inbox replies --format json --limit 200`
2. Filter for campaign_id 3577260 only
3. Skip any email_lead_id already in /tmp/speakeragent_posted_ids.json
4. For each NEW lead, fetch message history: `smartlead leads messages --campaign-id 3577260 --lead-id <id> --format json`
5. Classify using these rules (DO NOT use the classifier script — the error rate is too high):

CLASSIFICATION RULES (check in order, first match wins):
- OOO: "out of office", "on vacation", "away from", "maternity leave", "death in the family", "taking time off", "I have retired", "officially retired", "due to a high volume of emails", "we appreciate your patience", "I will reply to your email as soon", "closed for the holiday", "back in the office on"
- UNSUBSCRIBE: "unsubscribe", "remove me", "take me off your list", "stop mail", "stop email", "please remove us", "remove from your list", standalone "Stop" or "Stop."
- HOSTILE: "psycho", "slop", "spam", "delete whatever AI", "work on your own writing", "stop contacting me"
- NOT FIT: "not interested", "no thank you", "no thanks", "no thx", "not looking for", "all set for now", "no money for lead gen", "not a prospect"
- POSITIVE_INTERESTED (BOOK): "happy to chat", "suggest some times", "let's talk", "lets talk", "book a call", "set up a call", "calendar link", "I'd love to connect", "love to connect", "definitely looking for", "Sure." / "Sure!" / "Yes," / "Absolutely" as standalone first words
- POSITIVE_SOFT (INFO): "send me some info", "send more info", "tell me more", "how does it work", "piqued my interest", "sounds interesting", "send over the details", "send some links", "additional info", "what's your website", "can you let me know the fees", "let me know the fees", "upfront payment", "give me more info", "please give me more info", "I'm interested", "I am interested", "send me info"
- REFERRAL: "no longer with" + "contact" or "reach"
- Everything else: SKIP (not positive)

6. For each verified POSITIVE (interested or soft), post to Slack C0AFU5EH56X using send_message. Format each post EXACTLY like this:

🔥 BOOKED: {first_name} {last_name}
📧 {email}
🏢 {company_name}
💬 "{reply_text (first 400 chars, no HTML)}"

For positive_soft, use 📩 INFO instead of 🔥 BOOKED.

7. After posting, add each posted email_lead_id to /tmp/speakeragent_posted_ids.json so it never reposts.

FINAL RESPONSE: Just list what was posted (if anything) or say "no new positives." Keep it brief — one line per lead max. Do NOT post the full details in this response, they already went to the Slack channel.

jobs.name: Notion PM Daily Digest
jobs.prompt:
Query the AI Integraterz Notion Project Management databases and deliver a daily digest to Slack.

**Read-only — do not create or modify anything in Notion.**

Databases:
- Projects DB: `3533fa00-4c9d-818a-bd92-c9d91ceafc4c`
- Tasks DB: `3533fa00-4c9d-81f7-a1bb-e4bbfc23ebcd`

**EXACT FORMAT — reproduce this template character by character. Two blank lines between every section:**

```
:clipboard: AI Integraterz Daily PM Digest — {day}, {date}


:fire: URGENT
{urgent items or "Nothing urgent today."}


:pushpin: TODAY
{today items or "No tasks due today." with context about daily-standing projects}


:date: THIS WEEK
{items due within 7 days or "No active tasks due within 7 days." with context}


:warning: OVERDUE / STALE
{each item as a bullet with circle indicator: :white_circle: for low, :large_blue_circle: for needs attention. Format: "- :large_blue_circle: Project Name — explanation."}


{context paragraph about overall board state if relevant}

| Project | Completion | Overdue | Next Due | Health |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {project name} | {X% (done/total)} | {count} | {next task or "None"} | {circle emoji} {status note} |


:bulb: Summary: {1-2 sentence takeaway}


To stop or manage this job, send me a new message (e.g. "stop reminder Notion PM Daily Digest").
```

**Rules:**
- Two blank lines between EVERY section and sub-section
- NO bold or italic on section headers — just emoji + UPPERCASE
- Project health table: no blank lines between table rows
- Use :large_blue_circle: for projects needing attention, :white_circle: for neutral
- Include the "To stop or manage..." line at the very end
- No preamble, no sign-off beyond the digest itself

jobs.name: Instantly cold-email inbox monitor — every 30 minutes
jobs.prompt: Run the Instantly cold-email inbox monitor every 30 minutes. Use /opt/data/scripts/run_instantly_reply_daemon.sh (or run `python3 /opt/data/scripts/instantly_reply_daemon.py --once`) from /opt/data. Follow the canonical Instantly monitor workflow: scan all recent cursor-paginated /emails pages, follow next_starting_after until null or the bounded 10-page cap, filter inbound prospect messages using ue_type 2/3 plus connected sending-account exclusion, normalize body.text/body.html, strip quoted text before classification, and preserve local dedup state. Treat HTTP 429 or any fetch failure as an incomplete scan, never as zero replies, and never mark items processed during an incomplete scan. Require and report the __SUMMARY__ completion marker. Emit every newly discovered inbound reply, including positive, referral, neutral/ambiguous, OOO, unsubscribe, hostile, auto-responder, and dead classifications. Before drafting, verify whether a human/operator SENT reply exists after the inbound reply; if so, skip as already handled. Positive/referral/ambiguous human replies receive approval-gated drafts only. Never send any reply automatically. Never use “thank you for responding,” “thank you for the reply,” or “thanks for the reply.” When a prospect asks for a contact number, include Justin’s cell phone as 813-770-3712 and explicitly tell them to text first so Justin knows it’s them. Show drafts inline in the report, not in a sidecar JSON file. Every newly discovered reply must also be logged idempotently to the AI Integraterz Notion sales records: update/create the verified Lead and add an Outreach Activity with the reply body, classification, Instantly message/thread/campaign IDs, timestamp, and handling status; query before creating and do not duplicate. If Notion logging fails, report the exact error and do not claim it was logged. Airtable/Google Sheets logging will be added once the operator provides the chosen destination and credentials/schema. If there is genuinely no new reply, no draft, no error, and no logging event, respond exactly [SILENT].
